name: us-amended-return-form-1040-including-capital
description: How to correct a filed US Form 1040 series return with Form 1040-X in 2026, including rebuilding a mis-stated capital loss deduction or capital loss carryforward year by year. Covers the refund time limits (3 years from filing or 2 years from payment, and the lookback cap), early and extended filing dates, the $3,000 ($1,500 married filing separately) loss limit under 26 U.S.C. 1211(b), how 1212(b) keeps short-term and long-term character and uses adjusted taxable income, electronic and paper filing, the 20% excessive claim penalty, and tracking. Trigger on "amend my return", "Form 1040-X", "capital loss carryover wrong", "fix last year's Schedule D", "refund claim deadline". For individuals and their preparers. Federal only.
